name: diesel-hifi
description: Browser-based diesel truck engine simulator. Rust simulation core, WASM in a Web Worker, static Svelte UI.

scripts.test: pnpm wasm:build && pnpm wasm:test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.build: pnpm wasm:build && pnpm --filter web build && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs web/dist
scripts.build:subpath: pnpm wasm:build && pnpm --filter web build:subpath && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs web/dist-subpath
